FX-RESHAPE-001.says: The settings as they start: no source and no destination mask: the drawing, untouched.

FX-RESHAPE-002.says: Source mask 1, a square from (4, 3) to (8, 7); destination mask 2, the same square three pixels right; Percent 100, Elasticity Normal: the stripes in the square pulled right, the drawing's edges held.

FX-RESHAPE-003.says: Destination a tall strip from (5, 1) to (7, 9): the square squeezed across and stretched down.

FX-RESHAPE-005.says: FX-RESHAPE-002 with boundary mask 3, (3, 1) to (13, 9): nothing outside it moves, so columns 0 to 1 and 14 to 15 are the drawing's own.

FX-RESHAPE-006.says: FX-RESHAPE-002 at Elasticity Stiff: the pull spread wide.

FX-RESHAPE-007.says: FX-RESHAPE-002 at Elasticity Liquid: the pull kept near the edges.

FX-RESHAPE-008.says: The destination drawn the other way round: turned to wind the source's way first, so FX-RESHAPE-002's frame.

FX-RESHAPE-009.says: Destination a curved circle 5 across about (8, 5): the square rounded.

FX-RESHAPE-010.says: Percent keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 the drawing, frame 2 FX-RESHAPE-004's, frame 4 FX-RESHAPE-002's.

FX-RESHAPE-011.says: FX-RESHAPE-002 with the layer moved three pixels right: the masks are the layer's, so all of it moves with the layer.

FX-RESHAPE-012.says: The destination's path keyed from three pixels right at frame 0 to two rows lower at frame 4: the pull turns downward.

FX-RESHAPE-013.says: Percent keyed from 20 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 by an ease that passes its end: held at 100 at frame 2, the same as frame 4.

FX-RESHAPE-014.says: Source and destination the same mask: nothing to pull, the drawing as it is.

FX-RESHAPE-015.says: Source mask 4, of three. Nothing to reshape: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-RESHAPE-016.says: Destination mask 2, switched off. Nothing to reshape: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-RESHAPE-017.says: Boundary mask 3 with two masks. Nothing to reshape: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-RESHAPE-018.says: Elasticity "rubber", not one of the seven. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RESHAPE-019.says: Percent 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RESHAPE-020.says: Source mask -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RESHAPE-021.says: Boundary mask 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-RESHAPE-022.says: Percent keyed to 101 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
